description: This file defines a class C128AObject for rendering Code 128-A barcodes using PHP and the GD graphics library. It includes barcode data, rendering logic, and methods for drawing the barcode pattern.

classes.name: C128AObject
classes.description: A class for rendering Code 128-A barcodes with customizable size and style, including methods for calculating sizes and drawing the barcode pattern.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for the C128AObject class, initializes barcode parameters, character set, and patterns.

methods.name: GetCharIndex
methods.description: Returns the index of a character in the barcode character set or -1 if not found.

methods.name: GetBarSize
methods.description: Returns the width of a barcode bar based on resolution and pattern code.

methods.name: GetSize
methods.description: Calculates the total width of the barcode based on the input value and resolution.

methods.name: GetCheckCharValue
methods.description: Computes the check character pattern for the barcode data.

methods.name: DrawStart
methods.description: Draws the start pattern of the barcode.

methods.name: DrawStop
methods.description: Draws the stop pattern of the barcode.

methods.name: DrawCheckChar
methods.description: Draws the check character pattern in the barcode.

methods.name: DrawObject
methods.description: Renders the entire barcode onto the image, including optional text, start, data, check, and stop patterns.
